title: Clinical LC-MS/MS laboratory-developed test — CLSI-based profile
scope: Full validation of a quantitative LC-MS/MS laboratory-developed test (LDT / IVDR Art. 5(5) in-house device). Not for verification of CE-IVD kits.

evidence.summary_c62a: Criterion from CLSI C62-A (2014) as summarised in Lynch, Clin Chem 2016, Table 1. C62 has since had a 2nd (2022) and 3rd (June 2026) edition whose text was not available.
evidence.clsi_public: Study design taken from CLSI's own public descriptions of the EP document or from published summaries of it.
evidence.accreditation: Requirement from an accreditation checklist as quoted in a peer-reviewed article.
evidence.practice: Widely used state-of-the-art criterion reported in peer-reviewed reviews, not a CLSI requirement.
evidence.lab_defined: CLSI leaves the limit to the laboratory (biological variation, total allowable error, clinical need). No default is given on purpose.

how_to_read.rule: Acceptance criteria must be fixed in the validation plan before experiments start and not changed after seeing results (Stone & van der Gugten 2023).

sources.lynch2016: Lynch KL. CLSI C62-A: A New Standard for Clinical Mass Spectrometry. Clin Chem 2016;62:24-29. doi:10.1373/clinchem.2015.238626
sources.stone2023: Stone JA, van der Gugten JG. Quantitative tandem mass spectrometry in the clinical laboratory: regulation and opportunity for validation of laboratory developed tests. J Mass Spectrom Adv Clin Lab 2023;28:82-90. doi:10.1016/j.jmsacl.2023.03.001
sources.rappold2022: Rappold BA. Review of the use of LC-MS/MS in clinical laboratories: Part II - Operations. Ann Lab Med 2022;42:531-557. doi:10.3343/alm.2022.42.5.531
sources.clsi_ep05: CLSI EP05-A3 (2014) Evaluation of Precision of Quantitative Measurement Procedures - public description (clsi.org)
sources.clsi_ep06: CLSI EP06 2nd ed. (2020) Evaluation of Linearity - public description (clsi.org)
sources.clsi_ep07: CLSI EP07 3rd ed. (2018) Interference Testing in Clinical Chemistry - public description (clsi.org)
sources.clsi_ep09: CLSI EP09c 3rd ed. (2018) Measurement Procedure Comparison and Bias Estimation Using Patient Samples - public description and summaries
sources.clsi_ep17: CLSI EP17-A2 (2012) Evaluation of Detection Capability - published summaries
sources.cap_chm18825: CAP Chemistry/Toxicology checklist 2021, CHM.18825, as quoted in stone2023
sources.c62ed2_practice: Published methods validated 'according to CLSI C62-Ed2' (e.g. J Clin Med 2024;13:7056, testosterone)

requirements.text: Analyte-specific plan listing every experiment with its acceptance criteria, approved before validation starts; criteria not adjusted after results
Outliers may not be excluded without documented justification

reference_design.note: EP05 '20 x 2 x 2'; EP05 is addressed to developers, which includes laboratories developing an LDT

levels: at and within 25% of medical decision points

practice_notes.text: At least 20 days; 5-day studies underestimate imprecision
Sample preparation by the several analysts who will run the test

design.statistics: Nested ANOVA (day / run / replicate) to separate repeatability from within-laboratory precision

criteria.note: May be tightened from biological variation or total allowable error

hierarchy: Comparison with a higher-order reference measurement procedure
Materials with assigned values: JCTLM-listed CRMs, or EQA/PT material with RMP-assigned targets
Spike and recovery (last resort; second source of standard, second analyst)
design.coverage: Across the measuring interval; at minimum LLMI, ULMI and clinically relevant levels

criteria.basis: biological variation, expert-group guidelines, local regulation

design.coverage: Span the common measuring interval, including medical decision points; include samples from relevant disease states
statistics: bias with confidence interval at medical decision points
design.comparator_advice: Prefer another LC-MS/MS method; immunoassay comparisons may not assess accuracy
design.outliers: Re-analyse outliers with both methods; they may reveal matrix effects or interferences

experiments.name: LLMI / LoQ (and LoB, LoD if claimed)

estimators: non-parametric: 95th percentile (preferred when blanks give no peak)

lod.formula: LoB + 1.645 x SD of low-level samples

practice_note.text: In LC-MS/MS the LoB is often not meaningful; LoD is commonly taken as equal to the LLOQ

criteria.note: Rappold 2022 advises against S/N as a validation metric because it is software-dependent

experiments.name: Calibration

design.matrix: same biological matrix as the samples

experiments.note: C62-A applies the bias limit to all calibrators above the LLMI; FDA/EMA/ICH M10 accept 75%.

design.statistics: First-order (straight-line) weighted least-squares fit; deviation from linearity compared with an allowable deviation (ADL). Second- and third-order polynomials are no longer required.
design.superseded: C62-A (via EP06-A) used polynomial regression with 9-11 levels x 2-4 replicates (lynch2016)

criteria.note: EP06 requires the laboratory to set the allowable deviation from linearity

design.development_tool: Post-column infusion during development (qualitative, no pass/fail)
design.statistics: Matuszewski: matrix effect, recovery and process efficiency; IS-normalised matrix factor

criteria.consequence_if_failed: data showing that accuracy is not affected are required
data showing that accuracy is not affected are required

design.method: Paired difference: matrix (preferably patient sample) with and without the potential interferent at high concentration
candidates: drugs used for the target disease
isobaric and structurally similar compounds (e.g. steroids)
endogenous interferences in relevant disease states

criteria.description: Interferent must not alter the calculated concentration

criteria.relative_to: mean ion ratio of the calibrators

design.method: Extracted negative samples injected after samples of increasing concentration

criteria.output: carry-over limit (highest concentration that does not carry over)

design.endogenous: standard additions when the matrix is not blank

criteria.description: Analyte and IS recovery consistent, precise and reproducible

conditions: serum/plasma at every storage temperature and time
analyte in the blank matrix used for calibrators
in-house critical reagents (mobile phases, extraction solutions)
design.materials: Individual patient samples preferred; pools as alternative; not lyophilised commercial QC

criteria.note: C62-A gives no specification and refers to FDA bioanalytical stability experiments

design.alternative: transfer of a well-defined published interval, or method comparison as surrogate, with justification

run_acceptance_for_qc_module.note: Routine run checks reported as common practice; candidates for the QC module, not validation criteria.

checks.value: at least 3 (about 3x LLMI, mid-range, near ULMI) in duplicate; at least 5% of patient samples per batch

not_available: Exact wording and any changed criteria of CLSI C62 2nd (2022) and 3rd (2026) editions
EP17 non-parametric rank formula details and the C62 recommendation on LoB for LC-MS/MS
EP06 2nd ed. recommended number of levels and replicates
